description: `Readonly<T>` and `Object.freeze` only affect the top level; nested objects stay mutable.
A mapped type whose value side calls the same type on `T[K]`, transforming every depth.
`T extends (...args: never[]) => unknown ? T : ...` stops recursion at functions, which would otherwise lose their call signature.
Homomorphic mapped types return primitives unchanged and map arrays and tuples to arrays and tuples.
